page.checksIntro: These are the checker's rows for this level, by their ids in the check catalog. Building what this level describes, and following the guides it links, is what makes them pass. A row that checks something you do not offer does not apply.

groups.optIn: Checked only when the site owner opts in
groups.signedIn: Signed-in checks, not run by the checker yet

hosted.before: Rather not run an issuer yourself?
hosted.linkText: Ora can host Poppy on your domain, with your login, in front of your existing APIs.
hosted.label: Hosted option

levels.title: Be findable
levels.summary: Publish one public file that tells assistants where to go, and have your sign-in server confirm that the file is yours.
levels.size: Small. Two JSON documents, served over HTTPS. A day or less if you already run an OAuth server.

levels.title: Let agents in, signed out
levels.summary: Assistants prove who they are and get session tokens that expire. Outside MCP, each token works only together with a key the assistant holds.
levels.size: Medium. Changes to your token endpoint, and a proof check in front of every API. Days to weeks, depending on whether your OAuth server can bind tokens to keys.

levels.title: Let people sign in
levels.summary: People sign in on your own pages, choose what each assistant may do with their account, and can disconnect it later.
levels.size: Large. Sign-in and consent pages, account tokens, sign out, and an account settings page. Weeks.

levels.title: Optional surfaces
levels.summary: Let an assistant's browser join its session, let assistants talk with your own agent, and ask for confirmation before you act.
levels.size: Varies. Each surface is its own project: days for the browser join, weeks for conversations or operations.
